description: Live snapshot of any address on Base: ETH balance, balances of major tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, DAI, USDbC, cbETH, AERO, EURC) plus up to 20 extra token addresses you pass, transaction count, and whether the address is an EOA, a smart contract or an EIP-7702 delegated account. Use for portfolio checks, counterparty screening and payment verification. Costs $0.005 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

tokens.description: Optional comma-separated extra ERC-20 addresses to check (max 20)
